title: Regenerate the managed Quest block for Quest CLI 0.13.0
description: DEC-168 (7), dispatched by opum-agent. The opum-quest federated pin is now v0.13.0 (OMARK-86), but this repository own CLAUDE.md managed quest:agent-instructions block still declares Quest CLI 0.12.0 (the same pins-versus-block split as OMARK-78 versus OMARK-81 for 0.12.0). Regenerate the managed block for 0.13.0 with the routine managed-block write, npx --yes @opum-ai/quest@0.13.0 agents --update-instructions --target claude (the shared global quest binary is still 0.12.0). Only generated bytes between the markers change.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The quest:agent-instructions block in CLAUDE.md is regenerated for Quest CLI 0.13.0 (the managed block write), with no hand-written prose changed
lore check exits 0 and the Tracker integrity check (quest agents --check --require-installed --target claude) passes against 0.13.0
The regeneration lands through a PR into dev with the required checks green on the head

finalSummary: OMARK-89 done. Used the routine managed-block write via npx @opum-ai/quest@0.13.0 agents --update-instructions --target claude; only generated bytes changed (block version line plus the skill file new dashboard/migration content), no hand-written prose.
